rows.description: Multi-factor authentication, and defining the suitable authentication factors and their numbers as well as the suitable authentication techniques based on the result of impact assessment of authentication failure and bypass for remote access and for privileged accounts.
rows.api_check: Privileged users must use MFA
rows.pass_condition: All privileged human identities have MFA
rows.fail_condition: Any privileged human identity lacks MFA
rows.notes: Exclude approved break-glass/service identities only through an explicit exception list.

rows.description: User authorization based on identity and access control principles (Need-to-Know and Need-to-Use principle, Least Privilege principle, and Segregation of Duties principle).
rows.api_check: Detect excessive administrative permissions
rows.evidence_source: IAM policies/role bindings for users, groups and service identities
rows.pass_condition: No non-approved identity has unrestricted admin privileges
rows.fail_condition: Identity has broad admin permissions outside approved admin population
rows.notes: Start with wildcard actions/resources and Owner/Administrator-equivalent roles.

rows.description: User authorization based on identity and access control principles (Need-to-Know and Need-to-Use principle, Least Privilege principle, and Segregation of Duties principle).
rows.api_check: Detect public/cross-account/cross-tenant IAM grants
rows.pass_condition: No unauthorized external principal is granted access
rows.fail_condition: External principal or public principal has unauthorized access
rows.notes: Requires organization-approved external-account allowlist.

rows.description: Privileged access management.
rows.api_check: Privileged access must be controlled through PAM/JIT where supported
rows.pass_condition: Privileged access is protected by approved PAM/JIT controls
rows.fail_condition: Permanent privileged access exists where JIT/PAM is required
rows.notes: API can prove configuration; policy requirement itself needs validation.

rows.description: Periodic review of identities and access rights.
rows.api_check: Detect stale/inactive identities
rows.evidence_source: Last login, credential use, access-key last-used timestamps
rows.pass_condition: Inactive identities are disabled/removed within the configured threshold
rows.fail_condition: Identity exceeds inactivity threshold while remaining enabled
rows.notes: Make threshold configurable, e.g. 90 days.

rows.description: Periodic review of identities and access rights.
rows.api_check: Detect stale access keys / long-lived credentials
rows.evidence_source: Access-key creation date and last-used date
rows.pass_condition: Keys comply with organization age/usage policy
rows.fail_condition: Unused or over-age keys remain active
rows.notes: Threshold should be configurable.

rows.description: Single-factor authentication based on username and password.
rows.api_check: Enforce password policy for human IAM users where applicable
rows.pass_condition: Password policy meets configured complexity/history/length requirements
rows.fail_condition: Required password policy setting is weaker or disabled
rows.notes: Use only where password-based identities are in scope.

rows.description: Asset Management (subdomain-level control set)
rows.api_check: Discover all cloud resources and produce an asset inventory
rows.evidence_source: Resource inventory APIs across all regions/accounts/subscriptions/projects
rows.pass_condition: Every in-scope resource is discoverable and recorded
rows.fail_condition: Resource inventory is incomplete or API coverage is missing
rows.notes: This is a foundational collector rather than a compliance finding.

rows.description: Logical or physical isolation and segmentation of network segments in a secure manner which is required to control relevant cybersecurity risks, using firewall and defense-in-depth principle.
rows.api_check: Detect unrestricted inbound internet exposure
rows.pass_condition: Only approved public ingress exists
rows.fail_condition: 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 grants sensitive ports/services without exception
rows.notes: Check SSH/RDP/database/admin ports separately for severity.

rows.description: Isolation of production network from testing and development environment networks.
rows.api_check: Detect production-to-development/test network paths
rows.evidence_source: VPC/VNet/network topology, routes, firewall rules, peering
rows.pass_condition: Production and non-production networks are isolated per policy
rows.fail_condition: Direct path exists without approved controls
rows.notes: Topology policy is organization-specific.

rows.description: Restricting and managing network services, protocols, and ports.
rows.api_check: Detect unrestricted network services, protocols and ports
rows.evidence_source: Firewall/security group/NSG rules and exposed listeners
rows.pass_condition: Only approved ports/protocols are exposed
rows.fail_condition: Unapproved or broad port exposure exists
rows.notes: Create a normalized port-risk catalog.

rows.description: Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS).
rows.api_check: Check network intrusion-prevention capability
rows.pass_condition: Required preventive detection capability is enabled
rows.fail_condition: Required capability is absent/disabled
rows.notes: API can verify service/configuration, not operational effectiveness.

rows.description: Security of Domain Name Service (DNS).
rows.api_check: Check DNS security configuration
rows.evidence_source: DNS zones, resolvers, DNSSEC/status, logging where supported
rows.pass_condition: Required DNS protections are enabled
rows.fail_condition: Required DNSSEC/secure resolver/logging control is missing
rows.notes: Split into DNSSEC, resolver logging and unauthorized zone changes.

rows.description: Protecting against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks to limit risks arising from these attacks.
rows.api_check: Check DDoS protection for internet-facing services
rows.pass_condition: Required DDoS protection is enabled for public services
rows.fail_condition: Internet-facing service lacks required protection
rows.notes: Policy must define which workloads require protection.

rows.description: Encryption of data in-transit and at-rest, as per their classification and the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
rows.api_check: Detect storage resources without encryption at rest
rows.pass_condition: All required data stores are encrypted
rows.fail_condition: In-scope data store is unencrypted
rows.notes: Map data classification to encryption requirement.

rows.description: Encryption of data in-transit and at-rest, as per their classification and the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
rows.api_check: Detect public storage buckets/containers
rows.pass_condition: No unauthorized public storage access
rows.fail_condition: Anonymous/public read or write is enabled
rows.notes: One of the highest-value checks.

rows.description: Encryption of data in-transit and at-rest, as per their classification and the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
rows.api_check: Detect unencrypted network/database traffic where TLS is supported
rows.evidence_source: Database endpoint, load balancer, service endpoint TLS settings
rows.pass_condition: Encryption in transit is required and enabled
rows.fail_condition: Plaintext protocol/connection is exposed
rows.notes: Use service-specific secure transport checks.

rows.description: Secure management of cryptographic keys during their lifecycles.
rows.api_check: Check cryptographic key lifecycle configuration
rows.evidence_source: KMS/Key Vault/Cloud KMS/Vault key state, rotation, expiry, owners
rows.pass_condition: Keys have owner, lifecycle and rotation/expiry according to policy
rows.fail_condition: Key is unmanaged, expired or outside policy
rows.notes: Exact rotation interval is policy-defined.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Activation of cybersecurity event logs for critical information assets within the entity.
rows.api_check: Check audit logging is enabled for critical cloud services
rows.pass_condition: Required critical services generate audit logs
rows.fail_condition: Required audit logs are disabled or missing
rows.notes: Maintain service coverage matrix.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Activation of cybersecurity event logs for critical and privileged accounts accessing information assets as well as for remote access events within the entity.
rows.api_check: Check privileged and remote access events are logged
rows.evidence_source: Identity sign-in logs, admin actions, remote-session logs
rows.pass_condition: Required privileged/remote events are collected
rows.fail_condition: Required event source is not logged
rows.notes: Verify both event generation and destination.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Identification of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) techniques required for cybersecurity event logs collection.
rows.api_check: Check SIEM integration for security logs
rows.pass_condition: Required logs are exported to approved SIEM
rows.fail_condition: Required logs have no approved SIEM destination
rows.notes: API proves forwarding configuration, not analyst monitoring.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Continuous monitoring of cybersecurity event logs.
rows.api_check: Check continuous monitoring coverage
rows.evidence_source: Alerting rules, detections and monitoring integrations
rows.pass_condition: Required monitoring rules are active
rows.fail_condition: Monitoring capability is absent/disabled
rows.notes: Need an approved detection catalog for a true PASS.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Retention period of cybersecurity event logs (shall be at least 12 months).
rows.api_check: Check security log retention is at least 12 months
rows.pass_condition: Required security logs have >= 12-month retention
rows.fail_condition: Retention is less than 12 months or indefinite retention policy is absent
rows.notes: This threshold is explicitly stated in ECC-2.

rows.subdomain: Information System and Processing Facilities Protection
rows.description: Patch management for systems, applications, and devices.
rows.api_check: Check patch compliance for compute workloads
rows.evidence_source: OS/package patch state from cloud management or vulnerability service
rows.pass_condition: In-scope workloads meet patch baseline
rows.fail_condition: Critical/security patches are missing beyond threshold
rows.notes: Requires agent/management telemetry for guest OS.

rows.description: Periodic vulnerabilities assessment and detection.
rows.api_check: Check vulnerability scanning coverage
rows.evidence_source: Vulnerability scanner coverage and last-scan timestamps
rows.pass_condition: All required assets are scanned within the defined period
rows.fail_condition: Assets are unscanned/stale
rows.notes: Track both coverage and scan freshness.

rows.description: Vulnerabilities classification based on their severities.
rows.api_check: Check vulnerability severity classification exists
rows.pass_condition: Findings are classified by severity
rows.fail_condition: Unclassified technical vulnerabilities exist
rows.notes: Mostly a finding-data quality check.

rows.description: Vulnerabilities remediation based on their classification and the associated cyber risks.
rows.api_check: Check remediation SLA for critical/high vulnerabilities
rows.evidence_source: Finding age, severity, status and remediation SLA
rows.pass_condition: Open findings meet configured remediation SLA
rows.fail_condition: Critical/high findings exceed SLA
rows.notes: Make SLA configurable by severity.

rows.description: Scope of backups to cover critical technology and information assets.
rows.api_check: Check backup coverage for critical resources
rows.evidence_source: Backup policies, protected resources, backup jobs
rows.pass_condition: All required critical assets are protected
rows.fail_condition: Critical asset has no active backup policy/protection
rows.notes: Criticality classification must be available.

rows.description: Periodic testing for the effectiveness of backup recovery.
rows.api_check: Check backup/recovery test evidence freshness
rows.pass_condition: Required recovery tests completed within configured period
rows.fail_condition: No recent successful restore test
rows.notes: API can prove execution, but business recovery adequacy needs human validation.

rows.description: Use of web application firewall.
rows.api_check: Check WAF protection for public web applications
rows.pass_condition: All in-scope public web apps have WAF
rows.fail_condition: Public web app lacks WAF
rows.notes: Requires identifying web applications/endpoints.

rows.description: Use of secure protocols (e.g. HTTPS).
rows.api_check: Check HTTPS-only exposure
rows.pass_condition: HTTP is redirected/disabled and HTTPS is enabled
rows.fail_condition: Plain HTTP remains exposed without approved redirect
rows.notes: Also test external endpoint for actual behavior.

rows.description: User authentication, and the suitable authentication factors and their numbers as well as the authentication techniques shall be defined based on the result of impact assessment of authentication failure and bypass for users’ access.
rows.api_check: Check authentication protection for sensitive web endpoints
rows.pass_condition: Sensitive endpoints require approved authentication
rows.fail_condition: Sensitive endpoint is anonymously accessible
rows.notes: Requires endpoint classification.

rows.description: Use of secure protocols (e.g. HTTPS).
rows.api_check: Check TLS version/cipher configuration
rows.evidence_source: TLS policy on load balancer/API gateway/CDN
rows.pass_condition: Only approved TLS versions/ciphers are enabled
rows.fail_condition: Deprecated TLS or weak cipher is enabled
rows.notes: Excellent Prowler-style technical check.

rows.description: Multi-factor authentication, and defining the suitable authentication factors and their numbers as well as the suitable authentication techniques based on the result of impact assessment of authentication failure and bypass for remote and webmail access.
rows.api_check: Check MFA for remote/webmail access
rows.pass_condition: Remote/webmail users require MFA
rows.fail_condition: Remote/webmail access allows password-only authentication
rows.notes: Depends on organization's mail platform.

rows.description: Validation of the entity’s email service domains by using Sender Policy Framework (SPF), Domain Keys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance (DMARC).
rows.api_check: Check SPF record exists for corporate mail domains
rows.pass_condition: SPF record exists and is syntactically valid
rows.fail_condition: No valid SPF record
rows.notes: External DNS API/resolver is acceptable.

rows.description: Validation of the entity’s email service domains by using Sender Policy Framework (SPF), Domain Keys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance (DMARC).
rows.api_check: Check DKIM is enabled for corporate mail domains
rows.pass_condition: DKIM record/configuration is valid
rows.fail_condition: DKIM is absent/invalid
rows.notes: Requires known mail provider/selectors.

rows.description: Validation of the entity’s email service domains by using Sender Policy Framework (SPF), Domain Keys Identified Mail (DKIM), and Domain Message Authentication Reporting and Conformance (DMARC).
rows.api_check: Check DMARC policy for corporate mail domains
rows.pass_condition: DMARC exists with approved enforcement policy
rows.fail_condition: DMARC missing or policy is weaker than required
rows.notes: Recommended policy threshold can be configurable (none/quarantine/reject).

rows.description: Cybersecurity requirements for protecting data and information of the entity shall be implemented, based on its classification level.
rows.api_check: Check required data-protection controls are applied to classified storage
rows.pass_condition: Resources comply with rules mapped to classification
rows.fail_condition: Classified resource violates mapped protection rule
rows.notes: Requires classification metadata.

rows.subdomain: Information System and Processing Facilities Protection
rows.description: Centralized clock synchronization with an accurate and trusted source, such as sources provided by the Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization (SASO).
rows.api_check: Check centralized time synchronization where cloud telemetry supports it
rows.pass_condition: Required workloads use trusted time source
rows.fail_condition: Workload time configuration is non-compliant
rows.notes: Guest-level API/agent is required; cloud control plane alone is insufficient.

rows.description: Collecting and handling threat intelligence feeds.
rows.api_check: Check threat-intelligence feed integrations are configured
rows.pass_condition: Required threat-intel sources are connected
rows.fail_condition: No required feed integration is configured
rows.notes: Feed quality and operational use remain manual.

rows.description: Separation and encryption of the entity’s data and information stored on mobile devices and BYODs.
rows.api_check: Check mobile-device encryption/compliance status
rows.pass_condition: Required managed devices are encrypted
rows.fail_condition: Managed device is unencrypted/non-compliant
rows.notes: Requires endpoint-management integration.

rows.description: Deletion of the entity’s data and information stored on mobile devices and BYOD in cases of device loss or after the ending/termination of employment with the entity.
rows.api_check: Check remote wipe capability for managed devices
rows.pass_condition: Remote wipe is available/enabled
rows.fail_condition: Required remote wipe capability is absent
rows.notes: API can prove capability; process/testing is manual.

rows.description: The cybersecurity risk assessment procedures shall be implemented at least in the following cases: at early stage of technology projects; before major changes to technology infrastructure; during planning to obtain third-party services; during planning and before release of new technology services and products.
rows.api_check: Check risk assessments exist for major cloud changes
rows.pass_condition: Major changes have linked risk assessments
rows.fail_condition: Major change lacks risk assessment
rows.notes: Requires ITSM/change-management API -- evidence source is a GRC/ITSM tool, not AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI.

rows.description: The results of cybersecurity audits and reviews shall be documented and presented to the cybersecurity supervisory committee and the Authorized Official. Results shall include the audit and review scope, observations, recommendations, corrective actions, and remediation plans.
rows.api_check: Check cybersecurity audit findings have remediation records
rows.pass_condition: Audit findings have owner, action and remediation status
rows.fail_condition: Finding lacks action/owner/status
rows.notes: Use GRC/Jira/ServiceNow connector -- evidence source is a GRC/ITSM tool, not AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Resilience Aspects of Business Continuity Management (BCM)
rows.description: Developing disaster recovery plans.
rows.api_check: Check disaster-recovery plan/test evidence
rows.pass_condition: Required DR tests are current and successful
rows.fail_condition: No current DR test evidence
rows.notes: Cloud APIs can validate technical recovery tests; plan approval is manual.

rows.description: User authorization based on identity and access control principles (Need-to-Know and Need-to-Use principle, Least Privilege principle, and Segregation of Duties principle).
rows.api_check: Detect IAM policies granting wildcard actions on wildcard resources
rows.pass_condition: No unauthorized policy has Action:* and Resource:*
rows.fail_condition: Unauthorized wildcard admin policy exists
rows.notes: Flag exceptions separately.

rows.description: User authorization based on identity and access control principles (Need-to-Know and Need-to-Use principle, Least Privilege principle, and Segregation of Duties principle).
rows.api_check: Detect publicly assumable/trust relationships
rows.pass_condition: Only approved principals can assume roles
rows.fail_condition: Unapproved external/public principal can assume role
rows.notes: High-value lateral movement check.

rows.description: Periodic review of identities and access rights.
rows.api_check: Detect root/global administrator accounts used for routine operations
rows.pass_condition: Routine use is absent or explicitly approved
rows.fail_condition: Root/global admin used outside approved break-glass process
rows.notes: Provider semantics differ; normalize to privileged emergency identity.

rows.description: Restricting and managing network services, protocols, and ports.
rows.api_check: Detect unrestricted SSH (22) exposure
rows.pass_condition: SSH is restricted to approved sources
rows.fail_condition: SSH exposed to the internet
rows.notes: Separate critical finding.

rows.description: Restricting and managing network services, protocols, and ports.
rows.api_check: Detect unrestricted RDP (3389) exposure
rows.pass_condition: RDP is restricted to approved sources
rows.fail_condition: RDP exposed to the internet
rows.notes: Separate critical finding.

rows.description: Restricting and managing network services, protocols, and ports.
rows.api_check: Detect publicly exposed database ports
rows.evidence_source: Firewall rules, public endpoints and DB metadata
rows.pass_condition: Databases are private or restricted to approved sources
rows.fail_condition: Database endpoint is publicly reachable without exception
rows.notes: Maintain database-port catalog.

rows.description: Encryption of data in-transit and at-rest, as per their classification and the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
rows.api_check: Check database encryption at rest
rows.pass_condition: All in-scope databases are encrypted
rows.fail_condition: Database is unencrypted
rows.notes: Separate customer-managed-key requirement if applicable.

rows.description: Encryption of data in-transit and at-rest, as per their classification and the relevant legislative and regulatory requirements.
rows.api_check: Check block disk/volume encryption at rest
rows.pass_condition: All in-scope volumes are encrypted
rows.fail_condition: Unencrypted volume exists
rows.notes: Include boot and attached data volumes.

rows.description: Secure management of cryptographic keys during their lifecycles.
rows.api_check: Check customer-managed key rotation where policy requires it
rows.pass_condition: Required CMKs rotate within policy interval
rows.fail_condition: Required key rotation is disabled/overdue
rows.notes: Only apply to keys whose classification/policy requires rotation.

rows.description: Scope of backups to cover critical technology and information assets.
rows.api_check: Detect critical databases without point-in-time recovery where required
rows.pass_condition: PITR is enabled for protected databases
rows.fail_condition: PITR is disabled
rows.notes: Policy-driven check.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Activation of cybersecurity event logs for critical information assets within the entity.
rows.api_check: Check cloud control-plane audit trail covers all regions/accounts/subscriptions
rows.evidence_source: Audit trail configuration and organization-level coverage
rows.pass_condition: Required scope is fully covered
rows.fail_condition: Region/account/subscription lacks audit coverage
rows.notes: Important multi-account/multi-subscription check.

rows.subdomain: Cybersecurity Event Logs and Monitoring Management
rows.description: Retention period of cybersecurity event logs (shall be at least 12 months).
rows.api_check: Check log storage is protected from modification/deletion
rows.evidence_source: Object-lock/immutability, access policy, retention and deletion permissions
rows.pass_condition: Required log stores prevent unauthorized alteration/deletion
rows.fail_condition: Log store can be modified/deleted by unauthorized identities
rows.notes: Policy-specific; distinguish immutable from merely retained.
